answer: Sybil resistance works by tying identity to scarce compute. Each agent must solve a lightweight proof-of-work puzzle before its transactions propagate. The cost is tiny for one honest agent but explodes for a fleet. A single operator spinning up a comet swarm of fake wallets hits a wall: every forged identity needs its own ferrous-grade hashing effort, so the ripple of fake attestations they hope to seed becomes unaffordable at scale.
